primary_fix.title: Fix heap overflow in slice::join caused by misbehaving Borrow

follow_up.title: `slice::join`: borrow only once during length calc

upstream_duplicate_search.assessment: The official primary fix describes the same nondeterministic safe Borrow root cause and heap overflow; the follow-up implements the first-element single-borrow repair. This is an already-reported historical soundness bug, so no new upstream report is appropriate.
